title: feat: discount per customer (INV-212)
body:
Ticket INV-212: each customer can have a discount rate, between 0 and 30%, applied to the total excluding tax before VAT.

- `discounts` table and its reading in the store
- `total_incl_tax` applies the discount of the invoice's customer
- tests of the discount and of the rate bounds

Verified: `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`.
